I replied in your thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from your own message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13). You said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that you'd flagged it to support on #8841. That message names West yard Door 2 but not Marrow Fieldworks. I'm treating it as the Marrow Fieldworks issue because it was about your dealer account.

I looked only in places you can see yourself: your channels, the public files and our direct messages. I left out the guess you sent me privately, since you asked me to keep it to myself.
